payload.question: 上个月 GMV 最高的 3 个品类

metrics.label: GMV
metrics.description: 已支付订单的实付金额合计。包含之后整单退款的订单，不包含已取消（未支付）订单。

answer.text: 上个月（2026年9月），GMV排名前 3 的品类依次是：数码家电（26.89 万元）、生鲜（5.69 万元）、美妆个护（4.00 万元）。

queries.title: GMV
queries.sql:
SELECT
  p.category AS category,
  ROUND(SUM(oi.pay_amount), 2) AS gmv
FROM order_items AS oi
JOIN orders AS o
  ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
JOIN products AS p
  ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE
  o.status IN ('paid', 'refunded')
  AND o.order_date BETWEEN '2026-09-01' AND '2026-09-30'
GROUP BY
  p.category
ORDER BY
  gmv DESC,
  category
LIMIT 3
queries.executed_sql:
SELECT
  p.category AS category,
  ROUND(SUM(oi.pay_amount), 2) AS gmv
FROM (
  SELECT
    item_id,
    line_amount,
    order_id,
    pay_amount,
    product_id,
    quantity,
    unit_price
  FROM order_items
) AS oi
JOIN (
  SELECT
    channel,
    customer_id,
    discount_amount,
    gross_amount,
    order_date,
    order_id,
    pay_amount,
    refund_amount,
    region_id,
    status,
    store_id
  FROM orders
) AS o
  ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
JOIN (
  SELECT
    brand,
    category,
    product_id,
    product_name,
    unit_cost,
    unit_price
  FROM products
) AS p
  ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE
  o.status IN ('paid', 'refunded')
  AND o.order_date BETWEEN '2026-09-01' AND '2026-09-30'
GROUP BY
  p.category
ORDER BY
  gmv DESC,
  category
LIMIT 3
